questiontext.text:
Find \(Q_1,Q_2\) and \(Q_3\) of the following distribution.(Note: Leave your answer in \(2\) decimal places when necessary).

Class Interval

Frequency

Cumulative frequencies
{@x1@} – {@x1_1@} {@f1@} {@cf_1@}
{@x2@} – {@x2_1@} {@f2@} {@cf_2@}
{@x3@} – {@x3_1@} {@f3@} {@cf_3@}
{@x4@} – {@x4_1@} {@f4@} {@cf_4@}
{@x5@} – {@x5_1@} {@f5@} {@cf_5@}

Compute the following statistics

\(Q_1=\) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

\(Q_2=\) [[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]][[feedback:prt2]]

\(Q_3=\) [[input:ans3]] [[validation:ans3]][[feedback:prt3]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

To find the quartiles, we use this formula \(q=L+\left(\frac{\frac{1}{4}\times n-cf}{f}\right )\times i\)

Where \(L\) is the upper class boundary for the immediate class, \(n (i.e. n={@cf_5@})\) is the total frequencies, \(cf\) is the cumulative frequency for the immediate class, \(f\) is the frequency in that class and \(i\) is the class size

Finding \(Q_1\)

\(Q_1\) is \(\left (\frac{{@total_frequencies@}}{4}\right )\) item i.e \({@q1@}^{th}\) item which falls in the \({@class_q1@}^{@power_Q1@}\)class, \(cf={@choosing_cf@},f={@choosing_freq@}\) and \(i={@class_size@}\)

\(Q_1={@bd_q1@}+\left(\frac{\frac{{@total_frequencies@}}{4}-{@choosing_cf@}}{{@choosing_freq@}}\right )\times {@class_size@}\)

\(Q_1={@bd_q1@}+{@soln2@}\)

\(Q_1={@ta1@}\)

Finding \(Q_2\)

\(Q_2\) is \(\left (\frac{2}{4}\times{@total_frequencies@}\right )\) item i.e \({@q2@}^{th}\) item which falls in the \({@class_q2@}^{@power_Q2@}\)class, \(cf={@choosing_cf_q2@},f={@choosing_freq_q2@}\) and\(i={@class_size@}\)

\(Q_2={@bd_q2@}+\left(\frac{\frac{{2}}{4}\times{@total_frequencies@}-{@choosing_cf_q2@}}{{@choosing_freq_q2@}}\right )\times {@class_size@}\)

\(Q_2={@bd_q2@}+{@soln4@}\)

\(Q_1={@ta2@}\)

Finding \(Q_3\)

\(Q_3\) is \(\left ( \frac{3}{4} \times{@total_frequencies@}\right )\) item i.e \({@q3@}^{th}\) item which falls in the \({@class_q3@}^{@power_Q3@}\)class, \(cf={@choosing_cf_q3@},f={@choosing_freq_q3@}\) and \(i={@class_size@}\)

\(Q_3={@bd_q3@}+\left(\frac{\frac{{3}}{4}\times{@total_frequencies@}-{@choosing_cf_q3@}}{{@choosing_freq_q3@}}\right )\times {@class_size@}\)

\(Q_3={@bd_q3@}+{@soln6@}\)

\(Q_3={@ta3@}\)
